articles.title: Crypto Clarity Act flames out in failed U.S. Senate vote
articles.snippet: The years-long effort to set U.S. regulations for crypto markets couldn't muster enough support to make the leap over the Senate's final 60-vote hurdle.

articles.title: A hacker turned 25 cents of bitcoin into 46 billion fake BTC tokens on a DeFi bridge
articles.snippet: Two software bugs allowed the attacker to create more than 2,000 times Bitcoin’s maximum supply in unbacked syBTC. Symbiosis puts preliminary losses at 9.97 BTC.

articles.title: Standard Chartered predicts Arbitrum's ARB to rise 70-fold to $10, citing Robinhood Chain revenue
articles.snippet: The bank expects tokenization to make Arbitrum a favored network for traditional finance, even though ARB holders currently have no direct claim on the fees.

articles.title: How a simple coding mistake let a hacker drain $7.8 million from a crypto wallet
articles.snippet: Security firms traced the $7.8 million loss to a helper contract the wallet owner had authorized, not to Safe itself.

articles.title: Stablecoin growth could boost dollar dominance, US Treasury demand: BoE official
articles.snippet: A Bank of England policy maker said digital dollars could expand access to the US currency while turning stablecoin issuers into bigger buyers of government debt.
